ref_circuit.value: 1 uF >=25 V X7R, BST to SRC
VS, CS+, CS- tied to VBATT rail; SCP_TEST, ISCP, CS_SEL, TMR all to GND; FLT pulled up with R1; G2 has common source with G1 at SRC
direct to gates via 0 to 2.2 Ohm per FET (designer choice)

calcs.in: 3 x 211 nC max, dV 1 V, C1 none
INP1 0.29/0.91 us; EN 2.2/4.6/6.5 us; gate discharge 633 nC at 2 A = 0.32 us
calcs.result: INP1 path about 1.2 us, EN path about 6.8 us: meets 10 us

gotchas: Drive both INP1 and EN/UVLO from the 12 V loop: two independent off paths; EN off also kills G2.
Turn-on after loop closure takes 27 to 50 ms for the charge pump.
12 V loop node must be fast: keep RC under about 2 us.
DGX pin 16 absent: footprint must be custom.
VGS only monitored when CS_SEL low (p18).
EN low = 1.5 uA shutdown, charge pump off (p21), so restart needs the full TDRV_EN.

doc_deviations.finding: 100 V abs max, 95 V operating. 80 V is TPS4811-Q1 operating. Docs should say 100 V.
No VDS status output. FLT covers SC, CP UV, UVLO only. Use analog MID, VMOT, VSYS dividers. README's 2 status lines change.

doc_deviations.claim: PLAN 3.4 banks close onto bulk, no precharge
doc_deviations.finding: IPT015N10N5 at 54 V 10 ms SOA is 0.7 A; bulk cannot be soft-started in SOA and hard close gives kA inrush. Add VMOT precharge across bank B.

unverified: KiCad has no DGX footprint: build from the datasheet land pattern

bank_wiring.bank_A: 3 FET: drains VSYS, sources MID. U1 VS=VSYS, SRC=MID, GND=GND.
bank_wiring.bank_B: 3 FET: drains MID, sources VMOT. U2 VS must be VSYS (not MID: it floats when A is off), SRC=VMOT.
bank_wiring.fit: Source toward VMOT means body diode VMOT->VSYS, as required, single direction per bank. G2 of U2 drives the VMOT precharge switch.
